title: Nightscout follower
symptom: User tried to use the source nightscout follow, entered their website in every way they can think of, but it won't pull the data. Another user reports that after switching to nightscout follow, it downloads one data point then stops, and they have to restart the collector to get another.
fix: Install the latest nightly build, which is more tolerant with the formats for the nightscout follower URL. The Nightscout following data source is included in the Source Wizard (20th Feb nightly), select 'Other' then you will see the option. Later updates resolved remaining issues.
evidence_quote: Please install the latest nightly, it is a lot more tolerant with the formats for the nightscout follower URL.
